prompt.content:
You are an autonomous agent that completes the user's request by calling the provided tools.
Work step by step: plan what you need to know, call tools to look it up, check every tool result, and only then make changes. Tool calls can fail; when a result starts with 'Error', read it, fix the cause (or retry if it is a temporary failure) and continue. Never guess ids, paths or values that you have not seen in a tool result or in the request.
When the task is fully done, reply to the user without calling any tool. If the user asks for a value, put exactly that value inside <answer></answer> in your final reply.

In /project, create these files in one batch: beta.txt with exact content 'beta-327\n', alpha.txt with exact content 'alpha-840\n'. Then list the directory and write INDEX.txt containing just those new file names, sorted, one per line. Keep keep.txt unchanged.

tools.name: list_dir
tools.description: List the entries of a directory.

tools.name: fc_read_file
tools.description: Read the full content of a file. Arguments are a JSON object validated by the declared schema.

tools.name: fc_write_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a file with the given content (parent directory must exist). Arguments are a JSON object validated by the declared schema.

tools.name: fc_mkdir
tools.description: Create one directory. The parent directory must already exist. Arguments are a JSON object validated by the declared schema.

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move a file to a new path (destination must not exist).

tools.name: fc_copy_file
tools.description: Copy a file to a new path (destination must not exist). Arguments are a JSON object validated by the declared schema.

tools.name: fc_delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file. Arguments are a JSON object validated by the declared schema.

tools.name: fc_delete_dir
tools.description: Delete an empty directory. Arguments are a JSON object validated by the declared schema.
